_note: Policy answers used by the website chat assistant. Edit freely — the assistant never invents policy, it only repeats what is written here.
certificate: Yes — every programme ends with a verifiable X Education certificate once you complete the modules and the capstone project.
placement: We don't promise jobs or salaries. Every programme includes a capstone project you can show employers, and our advisors can help you plan your applications.
refund: If the course isn't right for you, write to support within 7 days of enrolling and we'll refund you in full.
payment: You can pay by card or UPI at checkout, in full or via monthly EMI. (Payments on this demo site are simulated — no money is charged.)
schedule: Classes are online and self-paced with weekly live doubt-clearing sessions, so you can study alongside a full-time job.
webinar: We hold a free live session every Saturday at 11 AM IST. You can reserve a seat from the home page.
contact: You can ask me here, request a callback, or email support@xeducation.example.
